purpose: Test whether the official Hyperliquid historical Explorer/L1 surface exposes a deterministic native validator-oracle schema around a frozen historical settlement boundary. This is source-provenance research only and does not reopen or rescue the closed primary replication.

official_source.historical_data_authority_note: Hyperliquid official historical-data documentation identifies explorer_blocks and replica_cmds as historical node data; official oracle documentation states validators publish native perp oracle prices approximately every 3 seconds.

frozen_probe.selection: Binary-search the first block whose blockTime is >= target; scan the fixed +/-150-height neighborhood. Do not adapt radius after viewing results.

allowed_outputs: queried historical block heights and block timestamps
canonical SHA256 fingerprints of raw block responses
top-level and nested JSON key paths
counts of key-path and type-label matches
whether an oracle-related schema key or action/type label exists

decision_rule.PASS_SCHEMA_CANDIDATE: At least one oracle-related JSON key path OR an oracle-related transaction/action type label is present in the fixed historical block neighborhood; this only permits a separately frozen P1 deterministic reconstruction audit.
decision_rule.FAIL_NO_NATIVE_ORACLE_SCHEMA_VISIBLE: Probe completes but neither oracle-related key paths nor oracle-related transaction/action type labels are visible; Explorer blockDetails is not sufficient for native-oracle reconstruction under this path.
decision_rule.TECHNICAL_BLOCKED: Endpoint unavailable, historical bracket cannot be established, response schema invalid, or fixed scan incomplete.
